source.authorityName: School examination paper (school not named); obtained from icseboard.org, originally from icseonline.com
source.notes: ICSE Class IX school physics paper (school not named). Header prints 'FINAL EXAMINATION 2024 - 2025', 'Std. IX', 'Date : 24/02/2025', 'Sub : Physics', 'Time : 2 hours', 'Marks : 80'; examYear 2025 from the printed date. Section A (Questions 1-3, 40 marks) is compulsory; Section B prints 'Attempt any four questions from this Section.' and has six 10-mark questions (4-9), so the pack's marks total (100) exceeds the 80 maximum. Question 1 prints only a group total [15] for fifteen MCQs and Question 2(i) only a group total [6] for six blanks; each is kept as one entry. In Question 4(iii) the printed acceleration value is struck through by hand and is not reproduced. No answer key is printed; no official answers exist. Handwritten marks on the scan were ignored.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
